notes.title: Update v.1.1.1367
notes.content:
Hey Nevermonsters!

Please welcome a new update (1.1.1367)! 


Here's what's included: 

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where NPC on the Farm would follow the dead players
[*] Fixed a bug where if one player would install a trap and leave the lobby, for other players the object that the trap was primed with would become indestructible and would float in the air
[*] Fixed a bug where a played was soft locked in the tutorial black room because of the backpack
[*] Fixed the hand motions (they now are not lacking behind). They are also more smooth moving now
[*] Fixed numerous minimal tutorial bugs
[*] Fragile items are now a bit sturdier
[*] Fixed a bug where long and big items would instantly fall through the floor
[*] Player move speed reduced to normal
[*] Safe door handles can now be grabbed more consistently
[*] NPC on the Farm are fireproof now (no longer are players able to murder them with any kind of fire weapon)
[*] Fixed a bug where you could crash the game by buying a lot of bombs from the shop at once
[*] Furniture fixes
[*] Tweaked weapon sounds
[*] Fixed an issue with ammo not stacking in the backpack properly
[*] The tape should no longer drop on the floor randomly for observers
[*] Sun is not black anymore
[*] Explosions tweaked
[*] Acetylene tank mass halved
[/list]
[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] New way of best region selection
[*] Zombies are now smaller
[*] Steam achievements
[/list]

[b]Also, you can purchase Requisition VR with the 50% off discount RIGHT NOW! Hurry up![/b]

notes.title: Full Release Update
notes.content:
Over the past 6 months and 15 updates, we have thoroughly reworked all game mechanics, enhanced crafting, reduced jankiness, and significantly optimized performance.

As the game leaves Early Access, development will continue. We are concentrating our efforts on developing the Survival mode on a massive map, one of the largest in VR gaming. Our aim is for REQUISITION VR to be the best survival game in VR, and we need your support to achieve this goal.

[previewyoutube=l2jTdUssrEk;full][/previewyoutube]

Many players requested firearm linking and improved gun sounds, so we've completely reworked the gunplay.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41329320/38cad74ea041b6fb3c4ec983a73f722ea2f971a6.png[/img]

Additionally, players asked for the ability to link items to rotating surfaces, which is now possible.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41329320/d6200a09ffa89362e48b3a23168dd83bc9e9db6a.png[/img]

Zombies and melee have also been redone almost from scratch. Zombie piercing mechanic returned
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41329320/d5376465291a3a2908d18c940b4eb4936bf72b4a.png[/img]

New types of zombies
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41329320/b5fbbe2ce5c9dcaec2079becca82ce323a37a5a2.png[/img]

More detailed information about the new update can be found below:

[b]#Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Numerous fixes to trap behavior and some items in traps.
[*] Fixed an issue with "sliding" weapons in hands on certain gamepads.
[*] Fixed issues with displaying sockets in furniture - now they are correctly hidden and displayed. Adjusted distance and manifestation speed.
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed players to grab items from their own backpack while it was on their back.
[*] Improved item synchronization.
[/list]
[b]#Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Weapon linking - now you can attach sharp objects (knives, katanas) to weapons, and add improvements like flashlights and laser sights.
[*] Zombies now dismember during explosions (arms and legs fly off).
[*] Added armored zombies. Until the armor is broken, it blocks damage to the body part it covers.
[*] Added zombies with buboes. When the bubo explodes, a toxic cloud appears, damaging the player.
[*] Improved backpack and pocket interaction interface.
[*] Sockettrig improvements - throwing behind the back, retrieving shotgun cartridges one at a time.
[*] Added a notepad containing background information on the game.
[*] Redesigned tutorial for better clarity and detail.
[*] Ability to remove items over the right shoulder into the backpack if the right operational socket of the backpack is already occupied by an item.
[*] Added the ability to manually remove magazines from weapons.
[*] Added a shooting range to the lobby.
[*] System for storing items in a backpack.
[*] Personal container system in the lobby.
[*] Added crafting workbenches to the lobby.
[*] Introduced functionality for unlocking skins through special boxes.
[/list]
[b]#Tweaks[/b]
[list]
[*] Simplified linking process - no need to hold one of the keys while winding.
[*] Redesigned teslagun projectile - now it actually flies and interacts with the first target it collides with during flight.
[*] Significantly reworked weapon sounds.
[*] Added sounds to items that were missing them.
[/list]

notes.title: 15th Update or REQUISITION 1.0
notes.content:
[h3]We have an important announcement:[/h3]
[previewyoutube=c5uNicuIi4w;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]REQUISITION VR is officially leaving Early Access on May 4 [/h2]


[h3]Update 1.0 is now available for you:[/h3]

[b][h3]#FIXES:[/h3][/b]
· Fixed a bug where linked weapons would get stuck in the air after stabs
· Fixed zombie corpse behavior (now they have realistic physical mass and die realistically)
· Fixed issues with some interfaces and menus. Now the in-game interface doesn't overlap with world objects
· Numerous visual fixes on game maps
· Numerous collider base fixes on game maps
· Numerous logic adjustments on game maps

[b][h3]#FEATURES:[/h3][/b]
· Added SURVIVAL MODE and survival mechanics
· Linking now restores item durability
· Added puppet to zombies: significantly improved zombie reactions to physical interactions
· Added linking with rotors
· Added item dragging through walls, preventing hand sticking and catching on door frame edges and other narrow surfaces
· Added cleanup of dynamic items that drop in Horde Mode or purchased in the store if they are inactive for a certain period of time
· Added new PDA (hand interface)
· Added the ability to push crawling zombies
· Reworked gun play: now it's much easier to aim with weapons, sights have been redesigned
· Added new zombie animations, replaced some old ones

[b][h3]#TWEAKS:[/h3][/b]
· Set correct item positions in traps
· Replaced remote grab indicator
· Significantly improved remote grab behavior - no longer possible to grab items through walls
· Reworked zombie climbing system
· Zombie animations became smoother
· Reworked some VFX
· Significant sound improvements, adding new sounds to items where they were missing
· Completely reworked socket rig and its interface:
· Fixed usability issues
· Added folding hints for backpack and wearable sockets
· Reworked hammer and duct tape logic - duct tape can no longer be taken out before the linking stage
· Reworked hand UI - now to open it, you need to look at your hand
· Changed weights of some items, adjusted grab poses
· Changed zombie balance: hp, attacks, damage

notes.title: Update #14: Improving zombies
notes.content:
[h3]#ZOMBIES[/h3]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where a zombie's visual would sometimes not match its hitboxes. 
[*] Fixed a bug due to which, after interrupting the run-attack animation, the zombie stopped in place, losing momentum.
[/list]
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Added stabs (the ability to pierce zombies with sharp weapons).
[*] Added interruption of hit reactions of zombies. You can now interrupt zombie attacks.
[*] Added an additive layer of animations when shooting at zombies (now they react to hits with animations).
[*] Added repulsion of zombies when shooting at them (the repulsion force depends on the specific weapon).
[*] Added interruption of attacks, and run-attacks of zombies. Now, if he tries to hit you, but realizes that the distance is too large - he will smoothly cancel his attack and again try to get to the distance necessary for the attack, and not hit the air.
[/list]

[h3]#FEATURES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added an icon indicating that the backpack is full
[*] Removed Christmas items and Valentine content
[/list]

[h3]#FIXES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with heroic holograms.
[*] Fixed a bug where during despawn zombies blood would appear even if it was disabled in the game settings.
[*] Disabled hand collision for dead players (now dead players can't push zombies or objects).
[*] Fixed network bugs that could lead to the removal of quest items when one of the players (not the host) left.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused some activated items to be enabled after linking, and were enabled until the moment of first use.
[/list]

[*] The button for opening the bunker in the house doesn’t work.

notes.title: UPDATE #12 - Fixing issues with launching the game & improved zombies
notes.content:
Hello there! 

We continue our work on improving REQUISITION VR in 2023. 

[h3]#FIXES:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed bugs that made it impossible to connect a headset to the game, especially Virtual Desktop users.
[*] Fixed an issue where zombies could walk through walls in some cases.
[*] Fixed an issue with incorrect zombie climbing animations. 
[*] Fixed an issue that caused zombies to move out of sync with their animations (like they were "floating" on the surface).
[*] Improved network sync of zombie position.
[*] Fixed bugs when zombies could "get up" or fly up in a T pose when they die.
[*] Fixed a bug where Horde Mode could freeze (zombies weren't spawning and it was impossible to end a session) if players log out of a session.
[*] Fixed a bug where there could be more zombies on the map than supposed.
[*] Fixed issues with crashing of the game.
[*] Fixed an issue when PDA opened the menu by accidental pressing when the player wasn’t looking at it. 
[*] Fixed an issue when an item while being pulled by grab from the distance pushes all other items around. 
[*] Fixed an issue where an item could be highlighted after it was removed from the socket.
[*] Added linkpoints to some items where they were missing.
[*] Fixed incorrect grabs of some items.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused fog to disappear on some maps.
[*] Fixed a number of bugs that could lead to a hard lock of a small tutorial and it was impossible to finish it.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could grab your backpack while you're dead.
[*] Optimized and improved performance of a hand animator on other players.
[*] Fixed issues with shotgun ammo.
[*] Fixed an issue with incorrect highlighting of the quest keys.
[*] Fixed collisions on the Sandbox map.
[/list]
[h3]#FEATURES:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added radio communications to the Town map (Story mode)
[/list]
[h3]#TWEAKS:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved sounds on some maps and objects.
[/list]

Best regards,
Arcadia VR

notes.title: REQUISITION VR UPDATE: New zombies, weapons & features
notes.content:
[h3]FIXES:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed incorrect calculation of survival time in Horde mode.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Portable Welder to deal damage at a great distance.
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause zombies to play incorrect sounds after/at the time of their death.
[*] Minor bug fixes in game locations (holes in the floor).
[/list]
[h3]FEATURES:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]New zombie models! Now they are randomly generated from more than 100 options.[/b]
[*] [b]Now all traps are reusable! After the first use, the trap recharges and is ready to use again.[/b]
[*] [b]Added native support for Oculus drivers. Now, when starting the game, 2 launch options are displayed - launch through Steam VR or through Oculus.[/b]
[*] New Heroic weapon - Molotov Cocktail! To assemble it you need to combine a bottle of whiskey and a rag.
[*] A vending machine for buying items and resources (in-game shop) is located at all locations of the Story mod. 
[*] Crafted items can now be placed in traps as long as they are not too large. Trap sockets will glow red if the item is too large.
[*] Added message about connection issues. This message also allows you to join the Discord server for help.
[/list]
[h3]TWEAK:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Balance: Damage balancing. All linked items now deal significantly more damage than regular items. The damage of some common items has been reduced.
[*] Lobby: Added visual markings to the floor marking all interactive areas. Slightly changed map lighting.
[*] Added sounds to some items that were missing them.
[*] Snap turn mode is enabled by default, which should reduce motion sickness for new players.
[*] Adjusted the size of the player's body sockets. Their position has been changed. Interaction with them should become easier.
[*] When linking an item that is part of a heroic to another regular item, the heroic recipe will now be displayed by default, reducing the instances where players use heroic-essential items in regular crafting.
[/list]

notes.title: PATCH #6
notes.content:
[h3]FIXES:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed hand physics. Now all items that are in the hands have a weight. Cabinet doors, house doors and car hoods no longer break. Weapons behave more realistically and naturally.
[*] Fixed incorrect two-handed grab of katana, and issues in which it flew out of the hands.
[*] Fixed a delay when first interacting with the character customizer.
[*] Reduced delay when changing clothes in the character customizer.
[*] Fixed incorrect wave counting in Horde Mode after restarting the game.
[*] Fixed issue with invisible items in large sockets of other players.
[*] Fixed visual issues on the Town map (PvP mode).
[/list]
[h3]FEATURES:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a “Catalog” of heroic weapons - displaying different information depending on what the player has crafted.
[*] Added an in-game store in the horde mode where player can purchase weapons, bombs, traps and aid kits using kill points. You can get kill points by killing  enemies. You can check your KP on your PDA. The store is planned to be added to the story mode as well later, based on your feedback.
[*] Added the ability to call a scorboard in Horde Mode at any time by pressing a special key on the PDA.
[*] Popup with quest tasks does not disappear till the player checks the PDA.
[/list]
[h3]TWEAK:[/h3]
[list]

[*] The shotgun now reloads much easier.

notes.title: PATCH #5
notes.content:
[h3]FIXES:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with corpses twitching after death.
[*] Fixed issues caused by Steam Overlay where player could fall through the map.
[*] Fixed issues with holes in maps that could cause players to fall off the map in some places.
[*] Fixed issue with incorrect visual display of the consumption bar.
[*] Fixed a number of errors on unloading from the map related to attempts to disable already inactive items.
[*] Fixes for various audio issues. Fixed a large number of missing object sounds, as well as general sounds (cutscenes, music).
[*] Fixed a problem with non-destructible windows - now windows can be destroyed by bullets, blows, throws.
[*] Window destruction effects now play again.
[*] Fixed an issue where items could still get stuck in some walls.
[*] Fixed an issue where some items (with low durability) could fall through tables, chairs, and other surfaces if you try to put them down.
[*] Fixed an issue where KillFeed in PvP could sometimes not display kill information.
[*] Tutorial: Fixed an issue that resulted in the toaster being placed back into the body socket when attempting to stow it away in a backpack.
[*] Story mode (Farm): NPCs no longer follow the "ghosts" of dead players.
[*] Story mode (Farm): Fixed random spawning of NPCs in cages. Previously, they appeared in the same places.
[/list]

[h3]FEATURES:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added forced launch of a small tutorial.
[*] Audio streaming - faster game loading, less consumption of RAM resources.
[/list]

[h3]TWEAKS:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed the ability to eject ammo from a shotgun by pressing a key. No more frustration with dropping ammo, reloading is only possible by bringing a box of ammo.
[*] Increased the thickness of the floor colliders on all maps. Items should now be less (or not at all) crushed under the floor.
[/list]

notes.title: Requisition VR patch 3 is out!
notes.content:
[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue when players chose a Singleplayer game in the main menu, and the Multiplayer sometimes started.
[*] Fixed an issue when the players consumed food to heal and it causes the endless consumption sound and affected the grab ability.
[*] Fixed a bug when as a result of crafting the player can get the weapon that was created before.
[*] Fixed a bug that made it impossible to complete story missions if one of the players left the game during the gameplay session.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the closure of the players' Scoreboard when one of them left Horde Mode.
[*] Fixed a bug when the electric bat didn’t expose any electric effect on impact.
[*] Electric bat now works correctly in PvP Mode.
[*] Fixed damage and status overlay on dead players. Previously players died immediately after respawning due to body damage in PvP Mode.
[*] Fixed an issue of items being stuck. 
[*] Now items don’t contact the environment for the first few seconds after being picked up. It also allows players to pick up weapons that are already stuck. 
[*] Fixed an issue with simultaneously pulling out and putting in the item into the backpack. Previously the backpack could fall to the ground. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the crafting machine on the workbench could “suck” items from the backpack, even if the backpack wasn’t in hands. 
[*] Fixed an issue with the backpack getting stuck in the walls.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could take the backpack in loading or in cutscenes. As a result the backpack could work incorrectly for the entire gaming session. 
[*] Fixed other backpack bugs that could cause it to fall to the ground and the players couldn’t pick it up.

[h3]Features: [/h3]
[*] Items retrieved from the backpack or its sockets are now instantly teleported to the hand and don’t “fly” towards it.
[*] Changed the order of triggers on the trap. A tripwire is now the default trigger (first trigger).
[*] Increased the speed of bullets.
[/list]

notes.title: REQUISITION day 1 + day 2 hotfix
notes.content:
Hello community! 

We did not waste time - but listened carefully to your feedback and then fixed our game. During the first 2 days after the release we have already made 2 patches. Here is a summary of what is included in the patches:

- Improved zombie animations and AI
- Fixed some crashes when starting the game
- Fixed some bugs with the freeze of the game at the start
- Fixed some bugs with long loading of locations
- Improved CPU load optimization
- Fixed a bug with fog on the Bunker map (did not cause damage and now it does)
- Fixed crash when using a flamethrower
- Fog has been added to the locations
- Fixed bugs with doors that broke physics and sometimes led to falling under the floor 
- Fixed an infinite connection (a spinning ring on the connection) that occur sometimes
- Added a button to change the region in the multiplayer menu
- Added a button for updating the list of rooms
- Fixed sync of basketballs in the lobby
- Fixed issue with the inverted camera on Pimax
- If players get stuck/fall under the map or can't grab items, they can use the Unstuck button on the PDA
- Fixed hanging in the menu when players click Find Game where there are no existing lobbies
- Optimized loading speed that is going to solve the black screen crash (shown after the Unity logo). The current patch leads players directly to the foggy room and follows by cutscene. Attention: the foggy room doesn't have a loading Indicator yet, please wait, there are no freezes. We are implementing loading indicator in the next patches
- Fixed audio looping and sound remoteness

Best regards,
Arcadia VR
